prompt: Write a Python function named is_prime(n) that returns True if the integer n is prime and False otherwise. Handle n < 2 correctly. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.

Write a Python function named reverse_words(s) that takes a string of space-separated words and returns the words in reverse order, separated by single spaces. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.
Write a Python function named count_vowels(s) that returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive) in the string s. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.

Write a Python function named fibonacci(n) that returns the n-th Fibonacci number with fibonacci(0) == 0 and fibonacci(1) == 1. Use an iterative implementation so it stays fast for n = 30. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.
Write a Python function named flatten(lst) that flattens arbitrarily nested lists of integers into a single flat list preserving order. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.

Write a Python function named binary_search(arr, target) that searches a sorted list of integers and returns the index of target, or -1 if it is absent. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.

Write a Python function named word_frequencies(text) that returns a dict mapping each whitespace-separated word to the number of times it occurs, ignoring case (lowercase the words). Empty input returns an empty dict. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.

Write a Python function named run_length_encode(s) that compresses a string into run-length form, e.g. 'aaabbc' becomes 'a3b2c1'. An empty string returns an empty string. Output only one Python code block with the function definition.
